mapper.insert: insert into pbl.questionAnswer(username, school, lessonName, checkDate, questionType, questionContent, questionName, answerContent, pageName, referenceAnswer, answerType, questionId, score,comment,supplementary) VALUES (#{username}, #{school}, #{lessonName}, #{checkDate}, #{questionType}, #{questionName}, #{questionName}, #{answerContent}, #{pageName}, #{referenceAnswer}, #{answerType}, #{questionId}, #{score},#{comment},#{supplementary})
mapper.select: select * from pbl.questionAnswer where school = #{school} and lessonName = #{lessonName} and pageName = #{pageName} and username = #{username} and checkDate = #{checkDate}
select * from pbl.questionItem where pageName = #{pageName} and school = #{school} and lessonName = #{lessonName} and subject = #{subject} and checkDate = #{checkDate}
